name: Edit a file and retain it after refresh
description: Verifies the primary coding workflow edits a file and preserves the result locally.
steps: Change visible code in the editor
expected: The edited file opens with the changed content still present and the tab remains usable.

name: Create, rename, duplicate, and delete a project file
description: Verifies the mobile explorer supports the core file-management lifecycle.
expected: The renamed original remains in the explorer and the duplicate is removed.

name: Run project and use terminal commands
description: Verifies the integrated runtime opens the project preview and the terminal accepts supported commands.
expected: Runtime Preview opens and the terminal reports the workspace files.

name: Use source control and extensions
description: Verifies the IDE exposes local source-control and extension workflows.
steps: Enter a commit message and commit
Open Extensions and install an extension
expected: The commit appears in history, the selected branch changes, and the extension shows as installed.

name: Import and export a CodeForge project
description: Verifies project portability and Android packaging preparation controls are reachable on mobile.
expected: The project is restored and Android packaging configuration files are offered for export.
